summary: At task commit 8fb4d92f, companion-artifact grading is aligned with solver-visible text: instruction and operator-contract now grade companions for existence and well-formed UTF-8 only, while rds-snapshot.json retains canonical key ordering and report_digest over the stable subset. The prior health.report_digest phantom is closed. Forward and reverse requirement matrices are complete with only low-severity advisory gaps (JSONL parse depth, health status field specificity, outbox call-order proxy).

evidence.observation: Two short paragraphs plus seven domain bullets (within Edition 3 shape); binds four docs; states companion outputs as required UTF-8 JSON/JSONL artifacts not separately graded for line/key ordering; snapshot graded for canonical sorted keys and operator-contract report_digest stable subset.

Report table marks companions as required UTF-8 with no digest and ordering not separately graded; only rds-snapshot.json graded for canonical key ordering and report_digest; defines stable digest subset and cross-cutting invariants (outbox transaction, readiness, promotion READ_ONLY/no VIP, max_event_retries=5 audit).
WAL sequence continuity with has_gap, base-backup LSN/timeline binding, partial replay, closed Earliest/LatestRestorableTime window.
Dynamic immediate apply, static pending-reboot, family-default merge, boot-validation-gated clear, ResetDBParameterGroup pending-reboot markers.

Lag gate 10485760, LSN catch-up, write-lease revoke with READ_ONLY, endpoint swap without VIP/ARP on promotion; failover TTL lease, health-probe matrix with reason strings, VIP migration evidence flags.

34 pytest functions matching design test-map families; snapshot tests assert sorted keys and stable-subset digest; companion tests assert file existence, health.json parses as JSON with a status key, and no companion digest or JSONL ordering assertions; lifecycle/PITR/parameter/promotion/failover/outbox/auth/readiness F2P and CLI/schema/offline/fail-closed P2P covered.
Classification-only inventory of 30 F2P and 4 P2P tests across nine requirement families; used to confirm behavioral enumeration completeness, not as solver-visible authority.
Material requirements must remain in instruction or legitimate referenced contracts; delegated docs are technical contracts; graded schema fields must be discoverable from solver-visible sources.

findings.why_it_matters: Companion grading text requires well-formed UTF-8 JSON/JSONL only; the test additionally requires health.json to contain a top-level status key even though no solver-visible schema enumerates health.json fields. A contract-conforming readiness companion using other field names could fail.
findings.minimal_remediation: Either drop the status-key assertion and rely on json.loads well-formedness, or document the minimal health.json field set in the operator contract.

findings.why_it_matters: Instruction requires companions to exist as well-formed UTF-8 JSON/JSONL; tests check instances.jsonl and events.jsonl with is_file() only, so non-JSONL or invalid line content would not be caught.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optionally parse each JSONL line in the report F2P or add a narrow companion well-formedness helper assertion.

findings.why_it_matters: Contract requires same-DB-transaction enqueue with state changes; the test also requires create_outbox before update_status in FakeRepository.call_order, which is stricter than stated atomicity.
findings.minimal_remediation: Prefer rollback/co-presence semantics or document intentional enqueue-before-status ordering if required.

findings.why_it_matters: Instruction requires subscription matching on SourceType and event category; the test rejects mismatched SourceType but does not assert rejection when SourceType matches and category differs.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add one negative case with matching SourceType and non-matching category.

do_not_change: Closed companion-vs-snapshot grading split (existence/UTF-8 for companions; digest/canonical keys for rds-snapshot.json only)

report_digest stable-subset definition and digest-stability F2P
